tickets.title: INV-1 — Search inventory by name
tickets.description: Add an optional q query parameter to GET /items. Match item names by case-insensitive substring. Omitted q and an empty q return all items. Preserve insertion order, the existing response shape, POST validation and existing tests. Add focused tests in tests/test_search.py for matching, case-insensitive matching, no matches, omitted/empty q and unchanged order. Keep this task limited to search; do not add health checks or stock filters. Run uv run pytest inside the container.

tickets.title: INV-2 — Add a health endpoint
tickets.description: Add GET /health returning status 200 with JSON {"status":"ok"}. Put the health route in app/health.py and register its router in app/main.py. Add tests in tests/test_health.py proving the response is stable and a health request does not change inventory. Preserve existing items endpoints and tests. Keep this task limited to the health endpoint; do not implement search or stock filtering. Run uv run pytest inside the container.

tickets.title: INV-3 — In-stock filter (depends on INV-1)
tickets.description: Build on the accepted, manually committed INV-1 search implementation. Add an optional in_stock boolean query parameter to GET /items: true keeps quantity > 0, false keeps quantity == 0, omitted keeps both. Combine it with q using AND and preserve insertion order and response shape. Add tests in tests/test_stock_filter.py for both values, omission, combined search/filter and empty results. Preserve the search and original tests. Do not include INV-2 health changes unless they already exist in the chosen base. Run uv run pytest inside the container.
